verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions PCI DSS scope, card tokenization, or a guarantee that card data stays off merchant servers. The only nearby material is a hosted payment page (flutterwave-docs-37), which does not document tokenization or PCI scope reduction. Another doc (flutterwave-docs-36) describes collecting card details in the merchant's own UI, which points the other way.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my systems out of most of PCI DSS scope because card data is tokenized and never touches my servers
